
# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct — condensed

Be direct and be kind. Review code, not people.

- Assume the other person has context you do not, and share yours.
- Disagreement is fine; gatekeeping is not. "This is the wrong approach" needs a reason and an alternative.
- Credit what you borrow: an idea, a snippet, a design reference.
- Do not ship anything that harasses, doxxes or misleads users, including in theme names, copy or assets.

Unacceptable: personal attacks, sexualised language in project spaces, sustained disruption of a review, and publishing someone's private data or proprietary assets (including Cyberpunk 2077 art, fonts or models).

Report issues privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability/advisory flow](https://github.com/dan-netrunner/night-city-ui/security/advisories/new)
or by emailing the maintainer address on the commits. The reporter's identity stays private; the outcome is stated in public once the case is closed.
